title: Claude MCP servers expand AI chatbot into a full operating system #claude #mcpservers #aitools
description:
Claude Code introduced five MCP servers that expand its capabilities beyond a simple chatbot. Perplexity MCP enables live internet access, Playwright automates browser tasks, Firecrawl crawls websites for research, Glyph connects to image and video generation models, and Chrome MCP interacts with open Chrome tabs.

These servers transform Claude into a full AI operating system, streamlining workflows by integrating browsing, content extraction, and multimedia generation. The availability of these free tools offers users a significant productivity advantage by automating complex tasks and enhancing AI functionality.

This innovation highlights the evolving landscape of AI assistants, emphasizing seamless integration with real-world applications and multi-modal content processing, driving greater adoption and utility in various industries.
